chat.t: Hey.
What are you doing?
Are you busy? Or are you just leaving me on read?
What? Can you reply a bit faster?
Well, while I was practicing martial arts in my habit...
Maybe because the movements are so big, but it feels a bit tight...
I was wondering if someone could check it for me.
Thanks for checking my outfit today.
I'm worried about how to get approval for the top, though.

o: I'm drawing up a plan, so let's talk later.

chat.t: What plan?

o: Obviously, the plan to see your panties!

chat.t: Hey! Not you too!

lines.t: Hyah! Hah!
I saw Airen swinging her staff in front of the Feelharmony Monastery.
In front of the Feelharmony Monastery
Hey! You guys! Where do you think you're looking?
This is the holy Feelharmony Monastery!
Treating a nun who serves God as a side show... Shame on you!
Sigh... I guess today's viewing session is over.
I'll come back to repent tomorrow, Sister. See you...
Even if they are believers, gathering around as soon as I start training... It's way too blatant.
(And yet, she's the one wearing the most blatant outfit...)
You're working hard again today.
Oh? When did you get here?
I felt someone staring intensely at me... Was it you?
Hey, I was looking at you very gently.
Oh, really...?
Now that I think about it, I haven't done my cool-down exercises yet. I wonder if there's a good scarecrow around?
I'm joking, joking! Put that staff away.
Hey, I don't swing my staff for personal reasons.
But this "Stick of Justice" knows how to exact justice on its own.
So you're saying you're going to hit me!
Aaah!! A nun is hitting someone!
That's playing dirty!
Anyway, I'm glad you came. The reason I called you today is...
You wanted me to touch you because your clothes are too tight, right?
I don't recall ever asking for that!
Isn't "checking it out" the same thing?
Stop joking around!
Look. Doesn't it look uncomfortable to move in even to you?
I barely managed to get Mother Superior to allow these slits on the bottom, but...
She absolutely refuses to approve the top.
She got so startled and asked if I was converting to Celestial, so I couldn't help it.
It definitely looks tight.
It would be better if the chest area had a wider opening...
Right? It gets in the way every time I spin my staff.
I just want a habit that's comfortable to train in!
Sure, I can see how passionate you are about martial arts.
And that outfit where your panties look like they're about to show is honestly the best.
Huh? I don't think anyone has ever seen my panties before.
Is it because you got rid of everyone who did?
No! It's because my martial arts movements are so fluid that they barely keep my panties hidden!
Oh, come on, there's no way that's possible.
I'm serious! Mother Superior confirmed it herself!
Those people earlier came here just to see my panties too.
Sigh... Coming all the way to Feelharmony for that. Something is seriously wrong, but...
Fine, then I'll be the first person to see your panties.
Try if you dare. You'll never see them.
But training is over for today, so come back next time.
Sure, text me when you have time.
Oh, right. I won't be held responsible if you get hit trying to see my panties!
A nun is hitting someone!!
I haven't hit you yet! Not yet!

chat.t: What are you up to? Remember our promise?
Why aren't you replying?
Hmm... Want to see my panties?
As if I'd show you!! You only reply fast at times like this.
Honestly...
We're preparing a small event at Feelharmony right now. Want to come?

o: You're saying I can see them there, right?

chat.t: Well... you can try. Though you won't be able to anyway.
Hmm... Is it really the end?
What color are the panties I'm wearing today?
Heh, you still don't know?

o: No way... The color of the cookies is...

chat.t: Hmm, I wonder.

lines.t: I arrived at Feelharmony, where the Panties party was supposed to be held.
But contrary to my expectations, the monastery was full of kids.
Inside the Feelharmony Monastery
Over here!
This is a conspiracy by a nun.
I'm going home.
Why the long face?
Obviously there's no way you'd host that kind of event in front of little kids!
I'll make sure you pay for getting my hopes up like this later.
Are you really going back like this? You'll regret it.
If you want good fortune, you should accumulate good karma beforehand!
Who knows? If you devote yourself to Feelharmony...
Is this nun-style flirting?
I decline!
I'm joking. But the part about accumulating good karma is real.
The work itself is easy! Just help out the other sisters with their volunteer work.
Today's event is handing out cookies to the kids, so maybe you could help carry the boxes?
Cookies? Suddenly?
Yep! Feelharmony Special Cookie.
It's a very special cookie celebrating love born from the heart.
...So when is the part I'll regret missing coming up?
Well, during the break, I'm hosting a martial arts workshop.
I'll be demonstrating it myself, so you should keep your eyes peeled then.
Challenge accepted!
You'll work hard, right?
Of course!
And so, after running around carrying cookie boxes for what felt like forever...
In front of the Feelharmony Monastery
Alright, today I'm going to teach you all some staff martial arts.
First, you need to know how to hold the staff, right? Here, do it like this...
Alright, I won't miss a single second!
I barely blinked until the class was over, and...
Is that a steel skirt...? How did she jump and not show her panties?

I stared until my eyes watered while Airen demonstrated multiple times,
but I couldn't even catch a glimpse of a panty strap.
Whew... Glad the event went well.
So? How was your day today?
In the end, I didn't get to see your panties.
Having nothing but dirty thoughts the entire time at an event like this... You're really something else.
Anything to catch a glimpse of a cute girl's panties.
I'll give you credit for your persistence.
No one has ever stared at me so intensely before.
So... are you really that curious?
Of course I am.
Mmm... Well, since you took the time out of your day to come all this way...
I should give you something in return.
Don't tell me...!
Tada! Here's a cookie! Doesn't it look delicious?
I made it especially for you!
Panties-shaped...? You think I'm going to be satisfied with this!
Just take a bite! I bet you'll be super satisfied.
Hehe. See you next time!

chat.t: Are you busy right now?

o: This user is currently unable to reply.
If you have an urgent matter...

chat.t: Panties
You really love panties, don't you?

o: I'd love them even more if you showed them to me.

chat.t: That's never going to happen.
Anyway, help me shoot a martial arts video to upload on social media.
When I try to do it alone, I keep going out of frame.

o: Can I keep the video forever?

chat.t: Well, I'm going to lend you a separate camera to shoot it with, but...
I only need the original anyway, so I'll let you keep a copy.
In front of the Feelharmony Monastery, of course.
Thanks, I got the video!

o: I watched it at 0.1x speed, but your panties weren't in it.

chat.t: Why are you so obsessed with panties?!
Of course they wouldn't be in it!
But, well...
Nothing.
Let's keep getting along!

lines.t: In front of the Feelharmony Monastery
You're running here with quite some intensity.
A chance to see panties AND record them?!
An opportunity like this might never come again!
They sell panties at stores, you know. Why are you so passionate about this?
Panties only reach their true completion when worn by a beautiful girl.
Otherwise, panties are nothing but mere scraps of fabric!
If you're that serious, then I have to take this seriously too.
Pour that passion into recording my video.
Of course!
Could you stop shooting from a low angle first?
Where I aim is my business!
Sigh... I'm already worried...
Right foot here!
Followed by the left foot!
If a kick doesn't work, use the Stick of Justice!
Phew, all done! Let me see what you shot.
Here!
Hmm... Why is only my lower body in the frame?
It's just a shame I couldn't capture any panties.
Maybe asking for your help was a mistake...
Wasn't the footwork the main focus anyway? This should be good enough.
Your sophistry and excuses are truly next level.
Think of it as survival skills.
By the way, you're a nun from Feelharmony, which is famous for pacifism. Why do you train so hard?
Can't you just listen to people and spread the holy word like the other nuns?
Well, because that alone isn't enough to spread the faith...
Why the wistful look all of a sudden?
Just thinking about the past.
More importantly, didn't you hear a scream just now?
Did I?
If there's even a slight doubt, we have to go check it out!
Vermont Plaza
Eek! Please stop...
Don't you want to look like us, customer?
If you just sign up, we'll make you look just like us.
I... I don't really want to go that far...
What was that?
Why don't you speak up a bit? Huh?!
Stop right there! Can't you see you're scaring them!
What's this? A nun?
The strong shouldn't intimidate the weak!
Well, well. Looks like even a nun is interested in us.
Indeed. Hmm, she actually has a pretty well-balanced frame.
Ooh, that's a body that would look amazing with some muscle.
In that case, we should give her the perfect opportunity to become our poster girl.
Poster girl...?
Haha, we'll even let you take body profile photos afterward!
Hehe, we'll shoot every single pore in 16K resolution and use it for our ads!
Hey, what did you just say?
Huh? Who the hell are you?
I was first in line! Get behind me!
Get 'em, Airen!
Why are you getting fired up over that?!
How do you like the taste of the Stick of Justice, you villains!
Stop! Stop!!! We were just recommending a workout!
And I'm just spreading the faith!
Any faith we had just went out the window! Retreat! Fall back!!
Whew, I heard plenty of confessions again today.
But why were you just standing there in the back!
What do you mean? Do you have any idea how hard I was recording?
Really? You didn't just record my lower body again, did you?
Hmph, you underestimate me.
Wait, why is it actually normal this time?
I couldn't miss a shot of you so passionately spreading the faith.
Thanks. I knew I could count on you.
As promised, I'm keeping a copy, okay?
Sure, go ahead.
By the way... how are you planning to spread the faith with this?
I thought if anyone gets in trouble, they might remember this video and come to Feelharmony.
I wanted to show that we protect the weak and can help everyone.
Ah, now that you mention it, did I catch your panties...
I'm trying to have a serious conversation here...!
Sigh... Never mind. That is so like you.
And working so hard is so like you.
I wish the Abbess would see it that way too.
I'm tired, so I'll head back first.
